---
title: "Optimised Glider II"
---

A chronological record of questions asked about a 300 mm span foam glider optimised for minimum sink rate in trimmed glide. Each **chapter**
is one model — a vehicle, a fidelity, a method — and each **entry** is one
question asked of it, answered by code that runs when the page renders.

## How the chapters relate

Chapters are numbered in the order they were written, which is not the order they
depend on each other. A chapter whose model was copied from an earlier one says
so at the top of its `_model.py`, and that is what this is drawn from — so the
picture cannot disagree with the models.
